Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (Redwood Inference)

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for your time today — great discussion and appreciate the buying committee joining the demo. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum.

Summary of what we demoed:
- Low-latency serving with 99th p95 optimizations (observed ~120–150ms p95 on medium-sized test loads)
- Deployment options: Hosted API, Dedicated GPU pools (reserved), and Private VPC deployment
- Cost controls: batching, KV caching, quantization profiles; showed sample pricing for hosted vs dedicated
- Security/compliance: SOC 2, VPC options, KMS integration, audit logging (demoed audit dashboard)

Key decision criteria you called out:
1) Latency & reliability: p95 under 200ms for US production traffic
2) Cost predictability: clear SLOs and predictable unit economics for 1M+ tokens/month
3) Data governance: ability to run in a private VPC and integrate with customer KMS
4) Procurement & contract terms: standard SLAs, data handling language, and acceptable insurance/indemnity

Stakeholder mapping (as discussed) — please confirm or correct:
- Economic buyer: Tom Alvarez (VP Engineering) — will own budget/approval
- Security/compliance owner: Sara Johnson (Head of Security) — will take security questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence
- Procurement: Emily Chen (procurement) — will handle PO and contract process (please confirm)
- Legal: Rafael Mendes (legal) — likely to review contract redlines

Immediate next steps we propose:
1) Security deep-dive with Sara + infra on Wed Jun 30 at 10:00 AM PT — a 60-minute session to walk through SOC 2 artifacts, network/topology, and KMS integration. Please confirm attendees.
2) We will send: SOC2 snapshot + security questionnaire answers, a pricing matrix (hosted vs dedicated), and a draft SOW for pilot scope by EOD Monday.
3) Procurement checklist and sample contract redlines to help speed review.
4) Technical deep-dive with engineering (optional) to validate latency in your environment (we can do a 2-week pilot on dedicated capacity).

Attachments (links below): redwood-demo-recording.mp4, redwood-demo-slides.pdf, draft-sow-acme-v1.docx

Questions for you:
- Can you confirm the procurement contact (Emily) and expected PO timeline?
- Any regulatory/data residency concerns we should surface now?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the SOC2 snapshot and pricing matrix shortly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183
